name: boto3
description: Boto3 is a Python library for AWS, providing an interface to access and control various AWS services. It's a local-first alternative to AWS SDKs.
rationale: AWS SDKs are often too heavyweight for small projects or proof-of-concepts. Boto3 offers a lightweight way to interact with AWS without the need for full SDK installation.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
